question: What are the most influential papers on gut microbiome? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on the gut microbiome, based on citation counts, include studies on obesity-associated microbiomes, the structure and diversity of the healthy human microbiome, the impact of diet on the gut microbiome, predictive functional profiling using 16S rRNA, and core gut microbiomes in twins.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/nature05414","title":"An obesity-associated gut microbiome with increased capacity for energy harvest","citation_count":10874},{"doi":"10.1038/nature11234","title":"Structure, function and diversity of the healthy human microbiome","citation_count":10343},{"doi":"10.1038/nature12820","title":"Diet rapidly and reproducibly alters the human gut microbiome","citation_count":8730},{"doi":"10.1038/nbt.2676","title":"Predictive functional profiling of microbial communities using 16S rRNA marker gene sequences","citation_count":8120},{"doi":"10.1038/nature07540","title":"A core gut microbiome in obese and lean twins","citation_count":6938}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on the gut microbiome, based on citation counts, include studies on obesity-associated microbiomes, the structure and diversity of the healthy human microbiome, the impact of diet on the gut microbiome, predictive functional profiling using 16S rRNA, and core gut microbiomes in twins.
